svg.title: Three families of cues in how AI interacts
svg.desc: CALIBER groups observable AI behaviors into anthropomorphic cues, interactional cues, and relational cues. They describe how human AI appears, how a conversation creates connection, and how AI frames a relationship. The three conceptual illustrations come from Mathilde Cerioli's Stanford Trust and Safety Research Conference slide 4, also represented on page 7 of her Canva CALIBER deck. These illustrations show concepts, not observations of children or research outcomes.
